briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion deployment accelerates as US-China compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with Orion, Claude 4.5 and Gemini 3.0 all reporting major capability jumps this month. Funding surged past $11B in Q3 amid regulatory scrutiny and security concerns.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion enters final testing with multimodal reasoning benchmarks exceeding human baselines. Anthropic released Claude 4.5 while Google deployed Gemini 3.0 to enterprise customers. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B and xAI launched Grok-3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive CAN bus deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production for NVIDIA and AMD. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined hyperscale expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
